description:
Create a new local Generic repository in JFrog Artifactory named 'build-artifacts-generic'. After creating the repository, deploy the file located at '/home/ga/Desktop/commons-lang3-3.14.0.jar' into this repository. The artifact must be deployed to the specific target path: 'releases/v1.0/commons-lang3-3.14.0.jar'.

1. Login to Artifactory (admin/password).
2. Create a Local Repository with Package Type 'Generic' and Repository Key 'build-artifacts-generic'.
3. Use the 'Deploy' button in the Artifact Browser to upload the JAR file to the specified target path.
